tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-cosmic-blue
tokens.usage: Deep space depth, orbital authority, aerospace engineering trust,. Used as border on `.content-card:nth-child(1)`; text on `.btn-secondary`. 9.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-launch-orange
tokens.usage: Rocket thrust energy, ignition power, mission urgency, heat. Used as border on `.stat-card:nth-child(2)`, `.content-card:nth-child(2)`; text on `.stat-trend`, `.footer-link:hover`. 3.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-orbital-silver
tokens.usage: Metallic spacecraft surfaces, satellite materials, precision. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-title`, `.stat-insight`; border on `.stat-card:nth-child(4)`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-silver-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer-link`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-starfield-black
tokens.usage: Infinite space void, deep cosmos, professional seriousness,. Used as text on `body`, `.stat-card:nth-child(4) .stat-icon`, `.stat-value`. 18.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-nebula-purple
tokens.usage: Innovation energy, exotic propulsion, quantum communications,. Used as border on `.stat-card:nth-child(3)`, `.content-card:nth-child(3)`.

tokens.name: color-pure-white
tokens.usage: Starlight, data clarity, mission-critical information, clean. Used as text on `.logo`, `.logo-icon`, `.nav-link`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: badge-error-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.stat-trend.negative`; background on `.badge-error`. 4.6:1 on `page-bg`.
